Final Camera Raw Filter as read after pass 3 + the user's AI-mask refresh (doc 65 / layer 2). $BigT (AI-mask bitmaps) omitted: Subject, Sky, 8 People parts and 3 Landscape masks were made by the user and CANNOT be replayed from this JSON; digests in the XML identify them. After any scripted write the user must refresh the AI masks in the dialog (inbox 2026-11-19-claude-9751-ai-mask-refresh.md). The filter also carries the user's global HSL Luminance keys (\$LA_R 8, \$LA_O 23, \$LA_Y 13, \$LA_G 1; all \$HA_*/\$SA_* are 0) — set in the dialog after pass 2, outside \$LCs; they lifted orange rock/skin by ~+3.7 L* (canyon, sand) and ~+3.6 (face).

raw_so_manual.HSL (filter, user): Luminance Red +8, Orange +23, Yellow +13, Green +1 (set after pass 2; part of the final look)
